name: Digital Image Processing
topics: DIP Fundamentals, Sampling and Quantization
Explain the fundamental steps of a digital image processing system with a block diagram.
Differentiate between sampling and quantization and explain how they affect image quality.
Pixel Relationships: Adjacency, Connectivity, Distances
Explain the types of adjacency (4, 8, m) and connectivity with examples.
For the given image segment and set V, compute the De, D4, D8 and Dm distances between p and q.
Point Operations and Intensity Transformations
Perform contrast stretching, thresholding, intensity-level slicing, negative and bit-plane slicing on the given image.
Explain log and power-law (gamma) transformations and how different γ values affect the output.
Histogram Equalization and Matching
Perform histogram equalization on the given image and obtain the final image.
Perform histogram matching/specification to modify the given histogram to the desired histogram.
Spatial Filtering: Smoothing, Sharpening and Edge Operators
Apply 3×3 mean, Gaussian, median and Laplacian filters and the Sobel operator at the given pixel and compute the gradient magnitude.
Why is the median filter better than the mean filter for salt-and-pepper noise? Discuss the problems of the Roberts cross operator.
Frequency Domain: Fourier Transform, DFT/DCT and Filters
Compute the 2-D DFT (or DCT) of the given image and its inverse; check whether the DFT matrix is unitary.
Explain ideal, Butterworth and Gaussian low-pass and high-pass filters, the ringing effect and the convolution theorem; smooth the given image in the frequency domain with D₀ = 0.5.
Image Restoration: Noise Models, Inverse and Wiener Filtering
Define noise and its sources; explain four noise models with their PDFs.
Explain the degradation/restoration model; compute the restored image using inverse and Wiener filtering for the given G(u,v), H(u,v) and noise spectra.
Colour Image Processing
Explain the RGB, CMY and HSI colour models and pseudo-colour processing.
Convert the given RGB value to CMYK and grayscale.
Image Segmentation: Thresholding, Edges, Region Growing
Apply region growing (or region splitting and merging with a quad tree) to the given image with the given seed and threshold.
Explain edge detection and the Canny edge detector; list the types of thresholding in segmentation.
Image Compression: Redundancy, Huffman and Run-Length
Construct Huffman codes for the given gray levels/probabilities and find the coding efficiency and compression ratio.
Explain coding, spatial and temporal redundancy; differentiate lossy and lossless compression; compute compression using run-length coding.
Morphological Image Processing
For the given binary image X and structuring element B, compute dilation, erosion, opening and closing.
Explain morphology, structuring elements and morphological algorithms.
Representation, Description and Object Recognition
Explain boundary and regional descriptors with examples; compute the 4-chain code of the given boundary; explain PCA for image description.
Explain the steps of object recognition, pattern classes, and compare structural and decision-theoretic (Bayes) methods.
